## App review monitor: new 1-2★ App Store and Google Play reviews → Slack
Every morning: read the newest reviews of your app on both stores, keep only the 1- and 2-star ones with words in them, drop the ones an earlier run already reported and post the rest to Slack.

**Setup**
1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `Apify Header Auth`: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your Apify token>` (apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations). Select it in *Run App Store reviews* **and** *Run Google Play reviews*.
2. Replace the example apps: `appIds` in *Run App Store reviews* is Apple's numeric id (the digits after `/id` in an App Store URL) plus the storefronts in `countries`; `appIds` in *Run Google Play reviews* is the Android package name, with `languages` and `countries`.
3. Connect Slack in *Post to Slack* and pick the channel.

Actors: https://apify.com/kestrel/app-store-reviews-scraper and https://apify.com/kestrel/google-play-reviews-scraper — $0.004 per delivered review on each side. `maxRating: 2`, `requireText` and `sinceDate` are applied before billing, so the 3-5★ and the star-only reviews cost nothing: a day with 30 complaints across both stores costs $0.12, a quiet day $0. App and status rows are free.
